admission.justification: Writer, caller snapshot, choke division, bound, write-free stream and panel head together promise one attributed bounded row per completed call with a truthful head under the conditional domain: failed writes are counted in dropped with no cross-restart promise, and active earlier-kind lifecycle calls use that branch; no single place promises the whole chain.

guarantee: Every tool call completed on the host path lands exactly one facts-only row in the workspace river, attributed to its once-read caller and its started or addressed role and admitted under the river bound — unless the write fails, in which case the loss is counted in dropped on the next landed row and nothing is promised across a restart; calls owned by an active earlier-kind lifecycle use that branch instead. The panel names who called and when the river was last fed, while the stream itself writes nothing and deletes nothing.

title: Completed host-path tool calls land one bounded, attributed river row; failed writes are counted and restarts promise nothing
